title: Orange sauce for pork.
preamble:
1 small onion, thinly sliced

1 good inch grated ginger

2 tablespoons dark soy sauce

1 desertspoon Dijon mustard

2 desertspoons good marmalade
method: Combine onion, ginger, soy sauce, mustard, marmalade, garlic and honey in a small bowl and mix well.
Fry mixture in a pan for 10 minutes.
It can now be poured over pork for its final cooking or used differently (with perhaps more cooking).
